body:
> @nblock I think everything is addressed now. PTAL.

With `auth reject …` it'd be nice to have a newline after `access denied` to make it a bit nicer to read:

```console
tailscale ssh root@100.64.0.1
# Headscale SSH requires an additional check.
# To authenticate, visit: https://headscale.example.com/auth/exl0MuKY0LJycYQbUorDVewG
# Authentication checked with Headscale SSH.
tailscale: access deniedConnection closed by UNKNOWN port 65535
```

---

Should we print the auth-id in the server logs similar to node registration (e.g. `INF starting node registration using key: Q5kqEZOeQoP8kZuB9VGd2IDg`). A similar messages for a pending SSH auth request would be nice.
